bounds: One exact content/ruleset key, two requests, four queue attempts per request and one durable marker. Cache receipt false or rejection fails the attempt before completion. Scrub and any required pseudonym-map persistence form one abstract settlement before the marker.

Pre-enqueue and attempt marker reads are abstract atomic checks. Two simultaneous misses can both write and notify. A queued repeat or retry that reads an existing marker skips work. A completion observer failure after a confirmed marker does not start another attempt. Exhaustion joins its failure notification; the outcome of that observation is abstracted.

Real AgentRuntime and PGlite replay successful retry after false, refusal through exhaustion, and an observer rejection after confirmed commit using synthetic tier-0 input. They check the marker at completion, read/write attempt counts and a later deduplicated request.

The model assumes known marker write outcomes. Read failures, lost commit acknowledgments, concurrent pseudonym-map writes, marker deletion, durable job restart and inference correctness are outside this projection. LazyPiiDrain models startup and stop.

assumptions: No fairness. The model admits no marker retirement or expiry.

Weak fairness of each admitted request's enabled attempt, scrub, marker and observer settlements. Storage and observer settlement may fail. No later request, successful write or time deadline is assumed.
No fairness. An accepted request or pending operation can remain waiting indefinitely.
